pipeline_stages.integrity: Pinned commits for Core, Builder, Manager, 35 static modules, 4 dynamic plugins, and SDK 0.3.2. Checked into git root.
Checks out exact locked commits; builds worldserver.exe with static modules; extracts SDK headers; builds 4 DLL plugins against exported SDK.

Generates candidate-lock.json hashing real files and binding source commits; packages dist/ directory containing server/, sdk/, plugins/, source-lock.json, candidate-lock.json, sha256sums.txt, and updates/ channel metadata; creates preview-server-bundle.zip; uploads GitHub Actions workflow artifacts.

Consumes exclusively the downloaded preview-server-bundle artifact; verifies candidate-lock.json, binary hashes, ABI fingerprint, duplication guard, and sha256sums.txt; writes preview-qualification-verdict.json; uploads preview-verification-report.

Downloads preview-server-bundle, preview-verification-report, and preview-channel-metadata; verifies all candidate versions, hashes, and commits match across all three artifacts; verifies real cryptographic signature; fails closed if any mismatch occurs.

pipeline_stages.stable_channel_isolated: Stable channel (latest.json, production releases) completely untouched and unreferenced.

checkout_leakage_mitigations.workflow_artifact_isolation: preview-release.yml explicitly downloads preview-channel-metadata from the candidate run rather than reading local updates/ directory.
checkout_leakage_mitigations.verdict_binding: Pre-publish gate mandates preview-qualification-verdict.json matches candidate-lock.json candidate_sha256 and version.
checkout_leakage_mitigations.hash_invariance: All release assets are validated against candidate-lock.json SHA-256 before release creation.
